events.description: MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5721 m to 5742 m, with 15-30 klbf, 80-120 rpm, 25-33 klbf.ft, 600 gpm / 2550 psi. Notes: EDS#4 (CSR+UBSR). Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%. MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9.80 ppg. Using PWD internal gauge to estimate ECD and to calibrate MPD model. Backreaming 20 m at 5723 m and 5731 m due to surface torque increasing. Backreaming 5 m at 5737 m due to low ROP and backreaming 30 m at 5740 due to low ROP and BHA vibration. Observing stall with 33 klbf.ft at 5739 m. Observing MRIL tool failure at 5739 m.
MW: Troubleshooting MRIL tool. Obs.: Performing downlinks and manual mode switch, without success.

MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5742 m to 5747 m, with 15-37 klbf, 80 rpm, 25-32 klbf.ft, 600 gpm / 2550 psi. Notes: Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%. MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9.80 ppg. Observing failure to receive M/LWD signal.
MW: Troubleshooting M/LWD tools. Obs.: Performing downlinks and manual mode switch, with success.

MW: Drilling with 8 1/2" BHA from 5747 m to 5749 m, with 12-15 klbf, 70 rpm, 24-25 klbf.ft, 600 gpm / 2600 psi. Notes: Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%. MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9.80 ppg. Flushing kill and choke lines. Observing another failure to receive M/LWD signal.
MW: Troubleshooting M/LWD tools. Obs.: Performing downlinks and manual mode switch, without success.

MW: Performing dynamic flow check during 15 min, OK. POOH 1 stand keeping SBP to pressurize well with 9.8 ppg + 120 psi at the casing shoe. B/D drilling stand. Obs.: Selecting EDS#5 (CSR+LBSR / EHBS: LBSR). In parallel, holding a pre job safety meeting prior to POOH BHA #5.
MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA on DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 5741 m to 5702 m in open hole, at restricted speed of 2 min/stand.

MW: Connecting TDS and recording torque at multiple depths and RPMs. Notes: Circulating 9.0 ppg WBM @ 600 gpm. Keeping booster with 350 gpm / 550 psi, SBP 300 psi, Choke A 46-48%. MPD in AP mode @ 5547 m with 9.80 ppg.
MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA with DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 5622 m to 5435 m in open hole, at restricted speed of 2 min/stand.
MW: Performing dynamic flow check during 15 min, well static.
MW: POOH 8 1/2" BHA with DP 5 1/2" + DP 5 7/8" from 5435 m to 4450 m inside casing, at restricted speed of 2 min/stand.
MW: Trying set string on slips, without success. Trying adjust rig balance, without success. Note: It was necessary change rig heading to allowed operate with supply boat.
AW: L/D 6 5/8" DP GPDS65 landing string (53 out of 53 stands).
AW: Changing out elevator inserts to 5". Removing PS-16 slips from the rotary table and installing bushing.
AW: L/D 5" DP (16 out of 16 stands).
AW: Moving BHA #4 from derrick to rotary and performing troubleshooting. BHA #4 electronic tools available to use.
